## Creating ConfigmgrApi

To initiate an instance of `ConfigmgrApi`, you can use micronaut's `ApplicationContext`:
```java
/* imports
import io.micronaut.runtime.Micronaut;
import io.micronaut.context.ApplicationContext;
import org.openapitools.api.ConfigmgrApi;
*/

ApplicationContext context = Micronaut.run(/* ... */);
PetApi apiInstance = context.getBean(ConfigmgrApi.class);
```

Or the `@Inject` annotation:
```java
@Singleton
```
